![Provisions logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zmann85/Provisions/main/logo.svg)

# Provisions

**One button to eat, drink, potion or bandage, always with the best item in your bags. Plus raid bars for your flasks, elixirs and stims.**

A WoW Forever addon.

[**⬇️ Download the latest version**](https://github.com/zmann85/Provisions/releases/latest)  ·  [What's new](https://github.com/zmann85/Provisions/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

Provisions keeps a few general macros pointed at the right consumable. When you loot new food, level up or run out of a stack, **the buttons update themselves**. Put them on your bars once and never think about it again.

**Any game language:** Provisions knows the game's food, drink, potions, bandages and healthstones by their item ID, so it works whatever language your game is in. (An item added to the game later is only recognized on an English client, until Provisions' table has it.)

## Install
1. Open the [latest release](https://github.com/zmann85/Provisions/releases/latest) and download the `Provisions-…zip` file under **Assets**.
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\` (you should end up with an `AddOns\Provisions` folder).
3. Start the game or type `/reload`.

To update, repeat this and replace the old folder. Your settings are kept.

## Getting started
1. Log in. Provisions creates its buttons automatically.
2. Type `/prov` or click the **bread icon** on your minimap.
3. On the **Item order** tab, **drag the buttons onto your action bars**. Done.

![Item order tab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zmann85/Provisions/main/media/settings-item-order.png)

## The buttons
| Button | Uses |
|---|---|
| **EatDrink** | Best food and drink in one press, or as separate **Eat** and **Drink** buttons |
| **HealPot** | Best healing potion |
| **ManaPot** | Best mana potion |
| **Bandage** | Best bandage your First Aid skill allows |
| **Healthstone** | Best healthstone |
| **Rune** | Demonic Rune or Dark Rune (characters with mana) |
| **BuffFood** | Best Well Fed dish: its stat buff, plus +5% experience from kills in WoW Forever |

**Smart picks**
- **Strongest first** by default, or **weakest first** per group to use up old stock
- **Conjured** food and drink first, since they vanish on logout anyway
- **Skips buff food**, so your Well Fed food isn't wasted on regen
- Characters without mana **never get drinks**

## The item bar
A small bar shows what each button would use and how many you have left.
- **Click** an icon to use the item, **right-click** to pick a specific item for that slot
- Choose which item types appear, plus icon size and grow direction
- Lock it or make it click-through. **Alt + click** unlocks it any time

- Two small buttons at its end show or hide the raid bars

![Item bar with the right-click list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zmann85/Provisions/main/media/item-bar.png)

## Raid bars
Two more bars for your own raid consumables, a separate list for each character:
- **Raid bar**: lasting buffs like flasks, elixirs, buff food, juju, world buffs, scrolls, weapon oils and stones
- **Raid stims bar**: short-use items for certain fights, like protection potions, Free Action and Stoneshield

How they work:
- **Drag** an item from your bags onto a bar to add it, **click** to use it. Oils, stones and poisons go straight onto your weapon
- Items you've run out of stay greyed out with 0, as a restock reminder
- An icon **pulses orange** when you carry the item but its buff isn't on you (in raids), and gets a **green frame** with the time left while the buff is up
- **Right-click** an icon to move it, remove it or switch its glow. **Presets** fill both bars at once, starting with Protection Paladin
- Works in any game language: the buff is read from the game, not from tooltip text

## Settings
Everything is in one window: `/prov` or the minimap button.
- **Item order**: your buttons to drag onto your bars, and strongest or weakest first per group
- **Options**: one or two food & drink buttons, conjured first, skip buff food
- **Item bar**: what the bar shows, how it looks and how it behaves
- **Raid bar**: a page each for the raid bar and the raid stims bar, plus presets

Options and the bar layout are shared by all your characters. Item order, bar items, right-click picks and the raid bar lists are saved per character.

![Item bar settings: appearance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zmann85/Provisions/main/media/settings-appearance.png) ![Item bar settings: behaviour](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zmann85/Provisions/main/media/settings-behaviour.png)

| Command | |
|---|---|
| `/prov` | Open the settings window |
| `/prov info` | Show what each button currently uses |
| `/prov raid`, `/prov stims` | Raid bar and raid stims commands (add, list, clear, preset) |
| `/prov resetbar` | Move all bars back to the centre |
| `/prov minimap` | Show or hide the minimap button |
| `/prov reset` | Factory reset |
| `/prov debug` | List your consumables and how Provisions sees them (for bug reports) |

## Lightweight
It only scans when your bags change and never reads the combat log. Nothing it does in combat can get blocked, and it doesn't touch buff data the game keeps secret during fights.

## Bugs & ideas
Open an [issue](https://github.com/zmann85/Provisions/issues), or tell Ghaan in game. A screenshot of `/prov debug` helps a lot.

---

For the author: releasing

1. Put the new version as the first `## vX.Y` heading in `CHANGELOG.md` with its changes, commit and push to main.
2. GitHub Actions tags the commit, builds the zip, creates the GitHub release and uploads it to CurseForge.

Needs the repository secret `CF_API_KEY`. CurseForge project ID 1738354. The CurseForge description lives in `CURSEFORGE.html` (paste into the editor's source view).

# Provisions

## v1.7
- New: the raid bar. A bar for your own raid buffs (flasks, elixirs, buff food, juju, world buffs, scrolls, weapon oils and stones), a separate list for each character.
- New: the raid stims bar. A second bar for short-use items you only need on certain fights (protection potions, Free Action, Stoneshield...). It works the same way and has its own position and settings.
- Drag an item from your bags onto a bar to add it, or type `/prov raid add` or `/prov stims add` and shift-click the item. Right-click an icon to move it, send it to the other bar, remove it, switch its glow on or off, or pick main or off hand.
- Left-click uses the item. Weapon oils, sharpening stones, weightstones and poisons go straight onto your main hand (or off hand).
- Items you've run out of stay on the bar, greyed out with 0, as a restock reminder.
- Glow: an icon pulses orange when you carry the item but its buff isn't on you (in raids), and gets a steady green frame while the buff is up, with the time left on the icon. Each bar can glow for both, missing only, active only, or not at all. The raid bar shows both by default, the stims bar only active stims.
- Which buff an item gives is read from the game, so this works in any client language. Items Provisions doesn't know yet are learned the first time you use them.
- Presets: load a ready-made list onto both bars, starting with Protection Paladin. Right-click the + on a bar, use the Presets row in the Raid bar tab, or type `/prov raid preset protpaladin`. You choose whether to add what's missing or replace your lists.
- New: Demonic Rune and Dark Rune on the main item bar and as a Rune macro (classes with mana only). Runes have their own row in the Item order tab.
- New: a Buff food button on the item bar and a BuffFood macro: your best Well Fed (Nutritious) dish, for its stat buff and WoW Forever's +5% experience from kills. Buff food has its own row in the Item order tab. The "Show on the bar" chips now sit in two rows.
- New Raid bar tab in the settings (`/prov`) with a page for each bar: show it always, only in raids, or hide it; glow; lock; grow direction. Icon size is shared with the item bar.
- Two small buttons at the end of the item bar show or hide the raid bar and the raid stims bar (Item bar tab, Behaviour page: Raid bar buttons on/off).
- `/prov raid list`, `/prov raid clear` (and the same for `stims`). `/prov resetbar` now moves all bars back to the centre.
- Fix: the settings window opens on the first click (it needed two).
- Fix: recipes are no longer taken for food. A cooking recipe shows the tooltip of the dish it teaches, so it could end up on the Buff food button or in the Eat macro.
- Runes are also recognised from their tooltip text, in case the game's item IDs differ from Provisions' table.

## v1.6
- Works on game clients in every language. Provisions now comes with a table of the game's food, drink, potions, bandages and healthstones (read from the game itself), so it no longer needs English tooltip text. An item that isn't in the table is still read from its tooltip, which only works on an English client.
- Right after logging in, the macros and the bar are ready at once instead of after the tooltips have loaded.

## v1.5.3
- Fixed: logging in or reloading during a fight with the clickable bar on gave "Interface action failed because of an AddOn" and a bar that didn't work until the fight ended. The bar now appears once the fight is over.
- Fixed: after a fresh login, item or spell data loading anywhere in the game (tooltips, vendors, the auction house, other addons) could make Provisions re-check your bags up to twice a second for the rest of the session. It now only re-checks when the item it's waiting for loads.
- Items Provisions has given up waiting for no longer ask the game for their data again on every bag check (most noticeable on non-English game clients).

## v1.5.2
- Fixed: the bar and macros went empty after a reload on a flight path (or while stunned, feared etc.). They now keep their items, and refresh when you land.
- Items you could use once stay on the bar for the session, so a temporary "can't use that now" from the game no longer empties it.

## v1.5.1
- Fixed: food (or other items) sometimes missing from the bar and macros after logging in or switching characters, until your bags changed. Items whose tooltip text loads late are now picked up as soon as it arrives.
- Fixed: the bar and macros went empty while you were dead. They now keep showing what you'll use once you're back.
- New: `/prov debug` lists the consumables in your bags and how Provisions sees them.
- The first-login hint now points to the settings window (`/prov`, Item order tab) for dragging the buttons onto your bars.

## v1.5
- Options and the item bar (position, size, lock, click behaviour) are now shared by all your characters.
- Item order, which items the bar shows and right-click picks stay per character.
- `/prov reset` resets the shared settings plus this character's own.
